title: Julianna NDE 5345
content: I was 16 and with my boyfriend. We were both about to fix. I knew that I was about to inject a few cc's more than what I had been doing, but all I could think about was how much higher I would get. After injecting, I remember suddenly feeling like I needed to take a nap and l lay down on the bed. I then became aware of being surrounded by a bright white light. I found myself standing on one side of a canyon that stretched out as far as I could see, to the right and to the left of me. Looking down, as far down as I could see, it was all pitch black. I noticed that the source of the light seemed to be on the other side of the canyon. It seemed so close, and yet there was no way for me to get to it. I began to panic. I wanted so badly to be one with the light. Then I saw the palm of a hand – the hand was so huge! I could see it coming towards me to the point where the light shone through the webbing of His fingers. I heard a voice, a man's voice, strong and gentle, say the words 'Not yet'. I opened my eyes and was drifting in and out of consciousness. My friend was giving me CPR. I remember laughing when he said I had been dead for 5 minutes and had been turning blue. I remember this NDE so vividly! I am convinced that it was Jesus who pushed me back. I believe that the canyon I could not get around was hell.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Experiencer believed it was Jesus; saw a huge hand with light shining through the webbing of His fingers; heard a strong, gentle man's voice say, "Not yet".

environment.environment_other_detail: Standing on one side of a canyon stretching as far as she could see; looking down it was pitch black; light source seemed to be on the other side.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Heard "Not yet" and then opened her eyes, drifting in and out of consciousness while boyfriend performed CPR.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Bright white light and canyon/boundary scene occurred without reported OBE or tunnel; then a hand/voice said "Not yet" followed by return to bodily awareness during CPR.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Canyon-like boundary with pitch-black depth; only a huge hand and a brief verbal message ("Not yet"); experiencer interpreted the canyon as hell and the being as Jesus pushing her back.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Not yet"; "I had been dead for 5 minutes"; "turning blue"; "I believe that the canyon I could not get around was hell."
